about_the_game:
Dodge Deadly Lasers in First Person

Minimalist sci-fi levels are packed with laser drones that guard soda cans. Learn their patterns and watch your footing to avoid getting impaled by heated spikes. Try different routes and strategies while honing your reflexes. Learn to dance with the lasers.

Collect Items to Power Up and Unlock the Exit

Progress through each level by collecting the required amount of Suga soda cans. They have the added effect of boosting your speed with each pickup, allowing you to zip past lasers with more ease. Golden pull tabs add time to your countdown timer.

Survive for a Chance to Win a Huge Payout

In a world where the demand for bloody entertainment is high and opportunities are scarce, you find yourself signing up for Laserade - Suga Corp's annual contest for promoting their soft drink brand in which many perish for a chance to win $1M and unlimited soda.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Dodge lasers in a series of treacherous levels to win $1M and unlimited soda from the soft drink manufacturer, Suga Corp, in this sci-fi first-person reflex game.
